title: esp-skills configuration
description: Configuration for the esp-skills plugin. Every key is optional: missing keys fall back to references/config-defaults.json. Keys marked Reserved belong to skills that are planned but not shipped yet; they are accepted and validated, but no skill reads them yet. Never store secrets here.

interactive.description: Read by esp-plan, esp-review and esp-ship: when the skill stops to ask the user. off: never, plan: after planning, all: at every decision.

language.description: Language tag for generated prose (commit messages, PR descriptions, reports).

models.description: Model and effort per subagent role, read by esp-plan (explorer) and the orchestrator skills. Spawn sites resolve their role here (see references/model-selection.md).

builder.description: Builder model per plan milestone complexity.

root.description: Runs root directory. A leading ~ expands to the home directory.

retention_days.description: Reserved (run cleanup, not enforced yet): days to keep finished runs. 0 keeps them forever.

worktrees.description: esp-ship: git worktree location for task and parallel milestone worktrees (root). esp-merge: worktree removal after the merge (cleanup).

pattern.description: Branch name pattern when an issue ID is known. Tokens: {category}, {issue}, {name}.

pattern_without_issue.description: Branch name pattern when no issue ID is known. Tokens: {category}, {name}.

default_category.description: Category used when none is given or inferred.

categories.description: Suggested categories. Other values are still accepted.

style.description: plain: imperative title. conventional: Conventional Commits title (type(scope): subject).

plan_step_prefix.description: Prefix the title with the plan step ([Task N], [Milestone N]) when following a plan.

review_fixes.description: esp-fix-review: separate fix(review) commits, or fixup! commits of the commit that last changed the file.

base.description: Base branch. null uses the repository default branch.

draft.description: Open PRs as drafts by default.

attribution.description: Append the AI attribution line to the PR body.

body_from_run.description: esp-ship, and esp-pr with a run directory: build the PR body from run artifacts.

body_sections.description: esp-ship, and esp-pr with a run directory: sections of a PR body built from run artifacts, in order.

output_dir.description: Directory, relative to the repository root, where reports are saved.

review.description: esp-review: review dimensions, minimum severity and finding verification.

fix-review.description: esp-fix-review: review fix rounds, CI fixes, replies, deferrals, and the wait for the reviews and the checks (wait).

deferred_items.description: follow-up: record a follow-up item, reply and resolve. block: leave open, block the merge.

wait.description: esp-fix-review --wait and the esp-ship pull request tail: bot reviewers, trigger comments, and waiting for the reviews and the CI checks of the head commit.

trigger.description: Comment that triggers a review. null when the reviewer runs on its own.

default_reviewers.description: Reviewer short names from fix-review.wait.reviewers, used when --reviewers is not given.

auto_trigger.description: Post the trigger comment of each reviewer that has one.

checks_grace_seconds.description: After the head commit, an empty check list counts as pending for this long (checks not registered yet), then as no checks.

method.description: repo: pick from what the repository allows, using preference. Otherwise force one method.

ship.description: esp-ship: tracks, phases, plan and review modes, the milestone loop, workspace, gates, builder reuse and budgets. halt_on is also read by esp-fix-review.

phases.description: Phases to run, filtered per track. Absent: every phase of the track. The core phase of the track (implement or build) is required, and the orchestrated track always plans.

plan_mode.description: auto: plan only when the request needs it. skip: no planning model (reuse, import, inline, or a synthesized one-milestone plan). always: generate a plan even for a small prompt.

review_mode.description: auto: decide the internal review from the real diff, keep the pull request review. internal, pr, both: the reviews to run. none: no review (the merge still needs green checks).

auto.description: Thresholds of review_mode auto: the internal review is skipped only within both limits.

review.description: Review rules that override review_mode auto.

always_paths.description: Glob patterns: a changed path that matches one always gets the internal review.

internal_review_rounds.description: Internal review and fix rounds before the pull request. 0 acts like review_mode pr.

worktree.description: Work in a task worktree under worktrees.root when --worktree is not given.

dirty_tree.description: A dirty working tree: worktree runs the task in a task worktree and leaves the changes untouched, fail stops the run.

pr_draft_until_reviewed.description: Open the pull request as a draft and mark it ready once its body is in place.

max_files_changed.description: More changed files (estimated or actual) escalates to the orchestrated track.

escalate.description: false: never escalate. Over the file limit, continue and log it; a second gate failure halts.

budgets.description: Budgets per track, checked at each phase boundary.

max_retries_per_milestone.description: Builder retries after a failed verification before the build halts.

parallel.description: Parallel milestone batches in worktrees. auto: on when the plan has a batch of two or more and worktrees.root is usable.

max_parallel.description: Most milestones built at the same time.

commit_per_milestone.description: false squashes the milestone commits into one commit when the build ends.

gates_scope.description: milestone: builders and verifiers run the validation commands of their milestone plus gates.always, and the full gates run once before the push. full: the full gates everywhere.

gates.description: Gate commands (null auto-detects the command from the project), and the gates that always run in scoped validation (always).

reuse.description: Builder reuse: continue a builder with the next milestone while its estimated context stays within limit_tokens.

cost.description: Estimated context tokens of a milestone per complexity.

recap.description: esp-recap: runs roots to read (runs.root is always read), the default date range, and the fan-out threshold.

roots.description: Runs roots to read. A leading ~ expands to the home directory.

model.description: Model alias passed to the subagent spawn.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to the subagent spawn.

gateCommand.description: Shell command for the gate, or null to auto-detect.
